maintainer_comments.author: zuiderkwast
maintainer_comments.body:
> The hashtable itself shouldn't need to be aware of lengths.

I can agree about this point.

> The entry simply IS the entry

That's a set-like API you're describing. Most people are familiar with Set and Map-like APIs (key/value, like dict) but this one with key/entry is unusual.
